subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

By next March, / we will had been / living here for ten years.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'we will had been'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in future perfect continuous tense, which is formed by using "**will have been**" + **present participle** verb (-**ing form**).
 
• The auxiliary verb "**will**" is used to indicate future time, and "**have been**" is used to indicate the completion of an action before a specific time in the future.
 
• The error is in the verb form "**will had been**", which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct form is "**will have been**".

T herefore, the correct sentence is: ***"**By next March,** we will have been **living here for ten years."*

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.
